headline: Contested Fronts Stir as War Enters Day 499
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Callahan’s Passage remains the chief furnace: eight base events in two hours and 20 in the day, with eight Warden and two Colonial holdings amid sharply accelerating casualties on both sides. Weathered Expanse has likewise stayed unsettled, recording 39 events in 24 hours, though only one in the latest two; seven Colonial bases remain, with two sites neutral. Nevish Line has quieted in the immediate count, showing no event in two hours and six in six, but 39 across the day, while its holdings stand six Warden to two Colonial. Stlican Shelf has cooled from the earlier pace to two events in two hours and eight in six, retaining seven Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral base. Palantine Berm has become a fresh point of movement, with three events in the latest two hours and 33 in the day across seven Warden holdings. Stonecradle shows no event in two hours, but ten in the day, with seven Colonial and two Warden bases. The wider front remains largely fixed, and no victor is declared.
